title: The Consumer Protection Act, 2019 (Act 35 of 2019)
authority: Parliament of India / Ministry of Law and Justice
known_limitations: Read with S.O. 2351(E) (20 Jul 2020) and S.O. 2421(E) (24 Jul 2020) commencement notifications and 2021 pecuniary jurisdiction rules.

title: Consumer Protection Act, 2019 — Commencement Notification S.O. 2351(E)
authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
known_limitations: Applies to the provisions listed in S.O. 2351(E); remaining provisions commenced under S.O. 2421(E).

title: Consumer Protection Act, 2019 — Further Commencement Notification S.O. 2421(E)
authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
known_limitations: Brings Central Authority (CCPA) and specified remaining provisions into force on 24 July 2020.

title: The Consumer Protection Act, 1986 (Act 68 of 1986 — Repealed)
authority: Parliament of India (India Code)
known_limitations: Repealed w.e.f. 20 July 2020 by Section 107 of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019; applies only to pre-20 July 2020 causes of action/saved proceedings. Preserved original CPA 1986 PDF is scanned (no embedded text layer); verbatim saving clause is sourced from CPA 2019 Section 107 and SC Experion (2022).

title: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020
authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
known_limitations: Read with 2020 corrigendum and 2021 amendment (G.S.R. 328(E)); 2026 amendment remains pending Gazette verification.

title: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) (Amendment) Rules, 2021
authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
known_limitations: Amends Rule 4(2) requiring resident nodal officer appointment.

title: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) (Amendment) Rules, 2026
authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
known_limitations: Pending editorial/Gazette verification: extracted PDF text omits commencement date and portions of the notification; excluded from approved reliance until verified.

title: Consumer Protection (Jurisdiction of the District Commission, the State Commission and the National Commission) Rules, 2021
authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
known_limitations: Revises pecuniary limits based on value of goods/services paid as consideration; territorial jurisdiction under Section 34 still governs.

title: Consumer Protection (Consumer Disputes Redressal Commissions) Rules, 2020 (Original Fee Table)
authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
known_limitations: Rule 7 fee table was substituted w.e.f. 17 August 2023 by G.S.R. 606(E); use 2023 amendment for post-17 August 2023 filings.

title: Consumer Protection (Consumer Disputes Redressal Commissions) (Amendment) Rules, 2023
authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
known_limitations: Verify current fee schedule on e-Jagriti at filing time.

title: Consumer Protection (Mediation) Rules, 2020
authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
known_limitations: Referral to mediation is decided by the Consumer Commission subject to Rule 4 exclusions.

title: National Consumer Helpline (NCH 1915) — Official About & Contact
authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
known_limitations: Pre-litigation grievance mechanism only; does not pause the 2-year limitation period under CPA 2019 Section 69.

title: Department of Consumer Affairs — Consumer Protection Unit & e-Jagriti
authority: Department of Consumer Affairs, Government of India
known_limitations: Check live e-Jagriti portal workflows and document format requirements before filing.

title: Experion Developers Pvt. Ltd. v. Sushma Ashok Shiroor (Supreme Court, 2022)
authority: Supreme Court of India
known_limitations: Homebuyer apartment-delay dispute under CPA 1986 and RERA; not direct authority for retail e-commerce goods.

title: Maharashtra State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission — Grievance Redressal & e-Filing
authority: State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission, Maharashtra
known_limitations: Regional guidance for Maharashtra District and State Commissions; verify bench and territorial District Commission address before filing.

title: Maharashtra Consumer Commissions Directory (Mumbai, Thane, Raigad)
authority: State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission, Maharashtra
known_limitations: Verify telephone/email/office hours on grahak.maharashtra.gov.in before visiting or serving notice.

title: Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 (Act 45 of 2023)
authority: Parliament of India / NCRB Sankalan
known_limitations: Applies to offences committed on or after 1 July 2024 per S.O. 850(E); pre-1 July 2024 offences remain governed by IPC 1860 under Section 358 savings.

title: Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (Act 46 of 2023)
authority: Parliament of India / NCRB Sankalan
known_limitations: Governs FIRs/procedures instituted on or after 1 July 2024 per S.O. 848(E); pending pre-1 July 2024 proceedings saved under Section 531(2)(a).

title: MHA Gazette Commencement Notifications S.O. 850(E) & S.O. 848(E) (BNS & BNSS)
authority: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India
known_limitations: Establishes 1 July 2024 commencement date (distinct from 23 Feb 2024 publication date).

title: Indian Penal Code, 1860 (Act 45 of 1860 — Repealed w.e.f. 1 July 2024)
authority: Parliament of India (India Code / BNS s.358 Savings)
known_limitations: Repealed w.e.f. 1 July 2024 by BNS 2023 Section 358; continues to govern substantive offences committed prior to 1 July 2024.

title: Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (Act 2 of 1974 — Repealed w.e.f. 1 July 2024)
authority: Parliament of India (India Code / BNSS s.531 Savings)
known_limitations: Repealed w.e.f. 1 July 2024 by BNSS 2023 Section 531; applies to investigations/trials pending before 1 July 2024.

title: RBI Circular — Customer Protection: Limiting Liability of Customers in Unauthorised Electronic Banking Transactions
authority: Reserve Bank of India
known_limitations: Applies to scheduled commercial banks, RRBs, small finance banks, and payments banks; zero liability does not apply pre-reporting when customer negligence (sharing OTP/PIN/password) caused loss.

title: RBI Circular — Limiting Liability of Customers in Unauthorised Electronic Payment Transactions in PPIs (Non-Bank Wallets)
authority: Reserve Bank of India
known_limitations: Published 4 Jan 2019, effective 1 March 2019; applies to authorised non-bank PPI wallet issuers.

title: RBI Circular — Harmonisation of Turn Around Time (TAT) and Customer Compensation for Failed Transactions
authority: Reserve Bank of India
known_limitations: Published 20 Sep 2019, effective 15 Oct 2019; applies to failed authorised transactions without beneficiary credit, not completed scam transfers.

title: RBI Master Direction — Credit Card and Debit Card – Issuance and Conduct Directions, 2022 (Updated 07-Mar-2024)
authority: Reserve Bank of India
known_limitations: Updated through 7 March 2024; check specific chapter commencement dates where noted (e.g. Oct 2022 billing/tax capitalization rule).

title: Reserve Bank - Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2021 (RB-IOS 2021)
authority: Reserve Bank of India
known_limitations: Complainant must first file with the regulated entity and wait 30 days (or receive rejection/unsatisfactory reply) before filing on cms.rbi.org.in.

title: Banking Ombudsman Scheme, 2006 (Integrated into RB-IOS 2021 w.e.f. 12 Nov 2021)
authority: Reserve Bank of India
known_limitations: Superseded w.e.f. 12 November 2021 by the Reserve Bank - Integrated Ombudsman Scheme, 2021.

title: Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987 (NALSA Free Legal Aid Criteria)
authority: National Legal Services Authority / Parliament of India
known_limitations: Income ceiling and specific eligibility depend on State Legal Services Authority rules under Section 12(h).

title: Bihar Prohibition and Excise Act, 2016 (Regional Reference)
authority: Government of Bihar (Bihar Gazette, Extraordinary)
known_limitations: Regional statute applicable strictly in the State of Bihar; read with 2018/2022 Bihar amendments.
